status: Evaluated L3 tolerances, committed before any engine comparison with the Orekit dataset (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1; §9.3.2 item 3). Not yet reviewed or approved.

l3.storedTolerances: Not used: the tolerances stored in the Orekit file are not the approved L3 rows (tolerances.md §13 C-8); the values below govern.

references: Formulas of tolerances.md revision 4 transcribed in verification/src/tol/tolerances-r4.ts; inputs from the reference side of the Orekit dataset (§4.1 item 2)
producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 4 (approved by the owner 2026-11-15) §9.3.1 VT-15 L3
tolerance.formula: 3M·X_a, 3M·X_e, 3M·X_n, 3M·X_ψ with the per-side bounds of §9.3.1 (each side from its own post-maneuver state; at m = T tangential at an apsis, each tool uses its own event state, τ_E,eng(T) entering three times)

evaluatedAt.source: Orekit event state (position_m, velocityAfter_mps), conic in 320-bit

tolerance.orekitSide: a⁺, e⁺: Orekit's getters (outputs.elementsAfter); ĥ⁺, ĥ⁻ and ψ: evaluated by the test in binary64 from Orekit's event state, like the engine side
